stillRejected.description: A variant carrying a constraint the wrapper has nowhere to enforce disqualifies the primitive wrapper, because the wrapper dispatches on JSON token kind alone. Degrades to interface{} — and must say so.

timeOrNumber.description: A temporal `format` is a type mapping, not a constraint: the string branch decodes into time.Time exactly as the non-oneOf path does. It compiles to a wrapper and must NOT warn.

unconstrained.description: The same shape without constraints compiles to a typed wrapper, and must NOT warn.
